issues.title: A float barrier leaves the lower right of page 2 conspicuously empty
issues.explanation: In the current PDF, page 2 has a large unused lower-right column while text continues in the left column. The barrier immediately follows the deferred two-column Fig. 1 and prevents the framework prose after it from filling that space. Remove this immediate barrier and retain the existing \clearpage before Fig. 2; the current PDF already places Fig. 1 on page 3 and Fig. 2 on page 4, and the clearpage preserves their order and page separation.
